pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregular polygonal dark regions with distinct edge contrast and sharp angular transitions. Geometric shapes vary from four-sided to six-sided regions with high spatial dominance over the interstitial background.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light pathways forming a topological graph with predominantly 3-way junction nodes. Pixel thickness of the pathways remains relatively uniform across the visible flank and neck regions.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Mane along the upper dorsal neck displays a short, uniform serrated fringe with low-amplitude peaks against the background foliage.
